# SpanishDictionary.com Help Center

> > Official support documentation for SpanishDictionary.com, covering Premium subscriptions, Classrooms for teachers, vocabulary tools, pronunciation features, and mobile apps for iOS and Android.

SpanishDictionary.com Help Center provides comprehensive guides for learners and educators using the platform's dictionary, translation, vocabulary building, and grammar learning features. The site includes detailed documentation for teacher-specific tools like Google Classroom integration and assignment creation, as well as Premium feature guides and account management support.

## Key Topics

- SpanishDictionary.com Premium
- iOS and Android mobile apps
- Google Classroom integration
- Vocabulary lists and quizzes
- Classrooms for teachers
- Subscription management
- Regional pronunciations (Spain vs Latin America)
- Phonetic transcription (IPA and SpanishDictionary.com Phonetic Alphabet)
- Assignment creation
- Photo translation
- Grammar lessons
- Teacher guides
- App Store subscriptions
- Account settings

## Getting Started

- [Support - SpanishDictionary.com Support](https://help.spanishdict.com/collection/80-support): Main support hub for SpanishDictionary.com help center and resources

## Teacher Resources & Classrooms

- [Link a Google Classroom Account to SpanishDictionary.com (For Teachers)](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/173-link-a-google-classroom-account-to-spanishdictionarycom-for-teachers): Setup guide for integrating Google Classroom with SpanishDictionary.com
- [Vocabulary Assignments Overview](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/195-vocabulary-assignments-overview): Overview of Classrooms assignment types: vocabulary quizzes & grammar lessons
- [Create a Vocabulary Assignment](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/197-create-a-vocabulary-assignment): Teacher guide for creating vocabulary assignments in Classrooms feature
- [Create a Grammar Assignment](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/198-create-a-grammar-assignment): Teacher guide for setting up grammar assignments in Classrooms
- [Remove Students From a Class](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/207-remove-students-from-a-class): Teacher guide for removing students from Classrooms or Google Classroom
- [Delete a Class](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/209-delete-a-class): Instructions for removing classes from SpanishDictionary.com or Google Classroom

## Vocabulary Lists & Quizzes

- [Make a Vocabulary List in the iOS App](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/203-how-to-make-a-vocabulary-list-in-the-ios-app): Step-by-step guide for creating vocabulary lists in iOS app
- [Edit a Vocabulary List in the iOS App](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/150-edit-a-vocabulary-list-in-the-ios-app): iOS app tutorial for removing and excluding words from vocabulary lists
- [Delete a Vocabulary List](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/160-how-to-delete-a-vocabulary-list): Guide for deleting lists across platforms; explains All My Words behavior
- [Change the Input Method for Vocabulary Quizzes](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/147-change-the-input-method-for-vocabulary-quizzes): Configure quiz format (multiple choice, writing, speaking) on web & mobile
- [Can I Change the Translation Language in Vocabulary Quizzes?](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/255-can-i-change-the-translation-language-in-vocabulary-quizzes): FAQ on translation direction in quizzes; suggests inglés.com alternative

## Premium Features & Subscriptions

- [How to Cancel a Premium Subscription on the Website](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/182-how-to-cancel-a-premium-subscription-on-the-website): Guide to canceling Premium subscriptions via website vs iOS App Store
- [How to Cancel a Premium Subscription in the iOS App](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/183-how-to-cancel-a-premium-subscription-in-the-ios-app): Guide to canceling iOS Premium subscriptions via Apple App Store settings
- [Photo Translation in the iOS App](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/262-photo-translation-in-the-ios-app): Premium feature guide for translating text from iPhone/iPad camera images

## Dictionary & Pronunciation Features

- [Regional Audio Pronunciations](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/146-regional-audio-pronunciations): Configure Spanish/Latin America regional accents on web and iPhone/iPad
- [Phonetic Pronunciations](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/158-phonetic-pronunciations): Explains three pronunciation formats: syllables, SPA, and IPA transcription

## Learning Tools & Lessons

- [Jump Ahead in "Learn Spanish" Lessons](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/275-jump-ahead-in-learn-spanish-lessons): How to skip ahead using checkpoints in Learn Spanish course progression
- [Where Did the Instructional Videos Go?](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/251-where-did-the-instructional-videos-go): FAQ explaining video availability in grammar lessons by difficulty level

## Account Management

- [How to Change Your Username](https://help.spanishdict.com/article/180-how-to-change-your-username): Instructions for updating username via SpanishDict.com account settings
